newsitem.title: UK: Clyde says Gulf Canada "rhetoric" misleading.
newsitem.headline: Clyde says Gulf Canada "rhetoric" misleading.

text.p: Bid target Clyde Petroleum Plc on Tuesday accused predator Gulf Canada Resources of issuing misleading rhetoric to support its 432 million stg hostile offer for the UK oil exploration and production firm.
"The rhetoric is predictable, but shareholders should not be misled," Clyde's managing director Roy Franklin told Reuters.
He said Gulf Canada was selectively looking back to before 1993, when Clyde set out a new strategy, to try to demonstrate Clyde was a poorly performing company.
"Harking back to the late eighties or early nineties and previous strategies is quite frankly irrelevant and misleading," Franklin said.
